assetOnboardingSourceFile.description: Latest uploaded asset hierarchy file or spreadsheet containing the entity.

configurationLastUpdated.description: Indicates when the configuration of this asset was last updated.

id.description:
A unique identifier that can be manually assigned or generated automatically during object creation. This
identifier cannot be altered after the object has been persisted.

version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

trackingIdForImport.description: This ID is used to determine which import this entity belongs to.

failureModeLineItems.description: Failure mode line items where this expected sensor is used.

failureModeLibraries.description: Failure mode libraries this expected sensor belongs to.

unit.description: Expected {@link Unit} of the sensor measurement.

unitType.description: The type of unit represented by this {@link ExpectedSensor}. For example "Temperature", "Pressure", etc.

isMinRequired.description: Whether this is a minimum required sensor for asset class purposes.

sensorPositiveAnomalyWeight.description:
This field answers the question, "If the actual value
of the sensor is more than the expected value, then
how much of a weight does it have on determining the
seriousness of the anomaly?"

sensorNegativeAnomalyWeight.description:
This field answers the question, "If the actual value
of the sensor is less than the expected value, then
how much of a weight does it have on determining the
seriousness of the anomaly?"

sensorType.description:
A sensor can (broadly) be a CONTROL, INDEPENDENT,
or DEPENDENT sensor.
A CONTROL sensor is a process parameter that is set to a
pre-determined value by an operator. Eg. a setpoint sensor.
An INDEPENDENT sensor is a parameter whose values change
independent of the process. Eg. ambient temperature.
A DEPENDENT sensor is a parameter whose values change because
of the CONTROL and INDEPENDENT sensors. Eg. yield of a reactor.
If there are other types of sensors in your project, `remix` this
Type and add to the `string enum`s in this field.

displayName.description: Display name which attempts to use {@link ExpectedSensor#name name} field; otherwise, uses the {@link ExpectedSensor#id id} field.

sensorDataType.description:
The values of a sensor may fall into different buckets:
1. CATEGORICAL - sensor outputs are from a specific set
2. CONTINUOUS - sensor outputs can be any numeric value in a finite/infinite range
If there are other types of sensor data in your project, `remix` this
Type and add to the `string enum`s in this field.

assetSensorRelations.description: All related {@link ReliabilityAssetSensorRelation}. See {@link ExpectedSensor} top level doc.

failureModeLibrariesDisplayStr.description:
String that represents the first (alphabetical order) 3 {@link FailureModeLibrary} associated with this
{@link ExpectedSensor}. "..." is appended if more than 3 {@link FailureModeLibrary} are associated.

title:
An abstract, conceptual representation of a sensor which serves some function in the context
of an asset. Can be associated with actual sensors providing measurements.
name: ExpectedSensor
